messages:
linda: Heads-up — AcmeOps wants a private on‑prem deployment targetting Q3. Requirements: private control plane in their VPC, HSM/KMS integration, air‑gapped option, 2x GPU nodes, 99.95% SLA. Any immediate blockers?

elaine: Noted. I'll create an intake epic. Need feasibility estimate, lead time, and a first draft of acceptance criteria. @raj can you scope solution constraints?

raj: Quick initial scope: HSM requires vendor PKCS#11 support + network rules. Airgap requires offline artifact transfer and manual operator install. Rough end‑to‑end: 8–12 weeks assuming no strange infra constraints.

omar: SRE checklist: we need their network diagram, NTP + DNS config, CIDR for peering, and clarification if outbound to our controller is allowed. Also confirm if they need private control plane or just private data plane.

linda: They explicitly asked for private control plane in their VPC. Legal asked for SSA and latest SOC report before we start integration.

marta: From eng: runtime needs GPU node affinity and PKCS#11 access for HSM. We can package a thin operator for install (rpm/deb + helm), but airgap installers need extra QA. We have an internal PoC.

elaine: Draft acceptance criteria (first pass):
- Deployable via automated VPC scripts OR airgap installer
- HSM/KMS keys integrated and rotatable by customer
- Observability: token-level latency + per-route error logs forwarded to customer's SIEM
- Canary rollout path and rollback plan established
- Legal + compliance sign-off on dataflow

raj: Dependencies to surface in backlog:
1) HSM vendor compatibility matrix and test keys
2) Installer packaging + kernel/driver deps for GPU nodes
3) Customer-provided infra diagram and IAM mapping
4) Dedicated staging cluster for final acceptance tests

omar: Timeline note: if customer provides full infra pack within 2 weeks and HSM access within 4, SRE can support staging readiness in ~6 weeks. Missing items add 3–4 weeks.

elaine: Prioritization: Sales says $500k ARR if we hit Q3. Requesting PM decision to mark this "high" priority for capacity planning. @marta @raj any objections?

marta: :thumbsup: No object as long as eng can allocate 2 sprints for integration + 1 sprint for acceptance testing.

raj: :eyes: One risk we should call out — strict network segmentation (PCI-like) will limit autoscaling and complicate our agent model. Add a fallback plan to the epic.

linda: I'll gather infra diagram + HSM vendor contact and update the intake doc. They agree to a staged canary with reduced capacity first.

deploy-bot: Deploy ticket created: DPL-4821 — staging cluster provision assigned to eng-oncall; ETA 2024-08-10.

elaine: Next steps: sales to upload infra pack to intake doc (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INTAKE-688) and schedule SSO/hsm handoff call. Product will convert acceptance criteria into backlog Epic and add the dependency checklist. I'll circle back after the infra pack is in.
